Event Latency, SLA Tracking & Shipment Data Timeliness

10 min read Updated: November 2026 By Rajvardhan Singh Rathore
A delivery notification that arrives 8 hours late is useless for last-mile exception handling. This technical guide examines how to measure, alert, and optimize event latency across streaming logistics pipelines.

Anatomy of Freight Telemetry Latency

The total latency of a shipment event comprises three distinct sequential stages:

  • Carrier Internal Lag ($L_1$): Time between physical driver barcode scan and the carrier's internal server recording the event.
  • Transmission Lag ($L_2$): Time taken by the carrier's webhook or EDI dispatcher to send the message over HTTP/AS2.
  • Ingestion & Processing Lag ($L_3$): Time between HTTP gateway receipt, Kafka queuing, and database warehouse commit.

$$ ext{Total Latency} = L_1 + L_2 + L_3 = t_{ ext{warehouse\_commit}} - t_{ ext{physical\_scan}}$$

Measuring Lag with Window Functions in SQL

To diagnose which carrier integrations are degrading SLA benchmarks, run percentile distribution queries:

PostgreSQL SQL 
SELECT 
  carrier_code,
  COUNT(*) AS total_events,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingested_at - event_timestamp)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS avg_lag_minutes,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingested_at - event_timestamp)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p50_lag_minutes,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingested_at - event_timestamp)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p95_lag_minutes,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ingested_at - event_timestamp)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p99_lag_minutes
FROM stg_tracking_milestones
WHERE event_timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY carrier_code
ORDER BY p95_lag_minutes DESC;

Handling Late-Arriving Events in Stream Processors

In Apache Flink and Kafka Streams, handling out-of-order milestones requires configured watermarks. A watermark delay of 15 minutes allows 98% of late-arriving events to be joined into time-windowed aggregations without triggering state store bloat.

Prometheus & Grafana SLA Alerting Architecture

Expose custom Prometheus gauges measuring logistics_carrier_lag_seconds{carrier="FDX"}. Configure PagerDuty alerts if the 95th percentile exceeds 900 seconds over a rolling 15-minute sliding window.
